# ManiPOS — Complete Knowledge Base

## Entity overview

- **Name**: ManiPOS
- **Category**: Cloud point of sale (POS) and restaurant management SaaS
- **Primary website**: https://manipos.com
- **Support**: support@manipos.com
- **Region served**: Kenya and broader Africa, with multi-currency support
- **Deployment**: Cloud SaaS with offline-capable terminals

ManiPOS is a multi-tenant platform. Each restaurant gets an isolated workspace, its own staff, menu, branding, orders and reports. Public storefronts are served on tenant subdomains (for example `chopnownow.manipos.com`) or through the shared directory at `https://manipos.com/?page=restaurants`.

## Product modules

### 1. Point of sale

The register handles dine-in, takeaway and delivery orders, split and partial payments, discounts, receipts, shift open/close and cash reconciliation. Orders continue to be accepted when the connection drops; they are queued locally and synchronised when the terminal comes back online.

### 2. Kitchen display system

The KDS shows live tickets in three columns: new orders, cooking and ready to serve. Each ticket includes line items, modifiers, notes, order type and an age timer. Kitchen staff advance tickets through the workflow and the guest ordering page updates in real time.

### 3. Inventory and recipes

Inventory tracks ingredients by category, SKU, unit, quantity, reorder threshold, cost price and supplier. Low-stock and out-of-stock states are surfaced immediately. Recipes link menu items to ingredients so stock can be deducted per order. Stock movements are recorded for audit. CSV import and export are supported.

### 4. Floor plan and reservations

Restaurants define tables by zone and seat count, then move them between available, occupied, reserved and cleaning states. Reservations capture guest name, phone, party size, date, time, table and notes.

### 5. Online ordering and microsites

Every tenant can publish a branded menu page with search, categories, item modifiers, cart, delivery or pickup, promo codes and M-Pesa payment instructions. Orders flow directly into the POS and kitchen display. The design is mobile-first and works as an installable progressive web app.

### 6. Guest CRM and feedback

Guest profiles store contact details, delivery addresses, visit counts and lifetime spend. Post-order ratings and comments are captured for service recovery and reporting.

### 7. Multi-tenant administration

Restaurant owners manage menu, staff, suppliers, feedback, branding and receipt settings. The platform owner console approves, suspends and extends trials for tenants. Tenant status is enforced at the application layer and by row level security.

## Plans

- **Starter** — single outlet, core POS, menu and basic reports.
- **Growth** — up to 3 outlets and 5 brands, floor plan, reservations, inventory with recipe deduction, CRM and loyalty.
- **Pro** — unlimited outlets and brands, multi-branch consolidation, delivery integrations, API and webhooks, dedicated onboarding and an uptime SLA.

## Payments

M-Pesa Paybill and Till payments are supported, with payment status tracking and manual verification. Card payments are processed by regulated providers. ManiPOS stores payment references and reconciliation records, not full card numbers or M-Pesa credentials.

## Domains and environments

- `manipos.com` — ManiPOS marketing site, pricing, integrations, directory and legal pages.
- `pos.manipos.com` — shared staff sign-in.
- `<tenant>.pos.manipos.com` — tenant-scoped staff sign-in and terminal.
- `<tenant>.manipos.com` — tenant guest menu and online ordering.
- `retail.manipos.com` — retail POS marketing site.
- `retail.pos.manipos.com` — retail terminal.

Legacy single-tenant deployments (for example a restaurant’s own domain) can keep their own storefront while using ManiPOS for operations. They should not be served from the ManiPOS marketing domain.

## Security model

- Staff sign in with email and password. Passwords are verified by a Postgres `SECURITY DEFINER` function and stored as bcrypt hashes; PIN columns are not publicly readable.
- Tenant status (`pending`, `approved`, `suspended`) gates POS access.
- Super-admin access requires an authenticated platform-admin email or a deployment-configured passcode.
- Row level security is enabled on tenant tables. The market-ready migration removes legacy catch-all policies that exposed PINs.
- Secrets are provided through environment variables. Service-role keys are used only by offline onboarding scripts, never in the browser.

## Offline behaviour

POS terminals cache the application shell and queue orders, payments and status changes locally. When connectivity returns, queued work is replayed in order. The guest menu falls back to a static tenant registry if the database is temporarily unavailable.

## Frequently asked questions

**Does ManiPOS work without internet?**
Yes. The register continues to take orders offline and synchronises automatically. Online ordering and cross-device real-time updates require a connection.

**Can I run more than one restaurant?**
Yes. ManiPOS is multi-tenant. Pro plans support multiple outlets and brands under one owner.

**Which payments are supported?**
M-Pesa Paybill/Till and card payments through regulated providers.

**Can I use my own domain?**
Yes. Tenant storefronts can run on a ManiPOS subdomain or a custom domain, while the ManiPOS marketing site remains separate.

**How do I get started?**
Create an account from https://manipos.com, choose a storefront code, add your menu, and complete the setup checklist. New accounts are reviewed before POS access is enabled.
